title: Laya offers fast typed decisions through Vercel AI Gateway
friendlyTitle: Laya is an AI model made for quick decisions
summary: Vercel AI Gateway has added Laya, a decision model that answers choice, score and yes-or-no questions with typed outputs and probabilities in one forward pass. It is positioned for routing, classification, guardrails and rubric-based evaluation rather than free-form writing.
friendlySummary: Laya returns clear choices, scores or yes-and-no answers instead of writing long text. It can help route tasks and check rules.
whyItMatters: Many workflows need a dependable decision, not another paragraph. A specialised model with structured output can simplify application logic, although teams should still calibrate thresholds and test errors against their own data.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This may make automated workflows simpler and faster, but each business should test how often its decisions are wrong.
